Data: MNQ 1s trades 23 Oct 2026 UTC (24 Oct NZDT), resampled to 5 Min OHLC. The standard says NQ DEC26; this is MNQ. Held-out window 24 Oct 07:10-08:40 NZDT is excluded from every chart. Window width: 36 bars of 5 Min (3 hours), not committed for 5 Min, open question for Gavin. SMAs on Close, warmed up on full history. Pick method: every bar whose 36-bar window has full SMAs and avoids the held-out time was put into above / below / crosses by its body vs Purple; up to 4 per group taken evenly spaced in time order. Cards: above 4, below 4, crosses 3. No other filters. Script: build.py.
